sources.title: Sidecar README
sources.locator: Overview, Usage, Core Features, Privacy, License
sources.finding: Describes the terminal dashboard with embedded agent terminals, td, git, files, Sessions screen, CLI verbs, install paths, requirements (macOS, Linux or WSL), no telemetry and MIT license.

sources.title: MIT License
sources.finding: Standard MIT license text.

sources.title: Comprehensive feature list
sources.finding: Feature inventory: workspaces with worktrees and merge workflow, conversations plugin (opt-in), td monitor, notes, themes, feature flags and diagnostics.

sources.title: Sidecar CLI reference
sources.locator: sidecar agent, api, create, host, layout, mobile, notify, open, session, shell, worktree sections
sources.finding: Generated reference for CLI verbs including agent start, prompt, wait, read, send-keys and broadcast, API pairing and service, host registration, notifications.

sources.title: The agent catalog
sources.finding: Agent families are TOML data with command, skip-permissions flag and resume arguments; users can override or add families in the config agents directory.

sources.title: Bundled agent family files
sources.finding: Bundled family files for aider, amp, antigravity, claude, cline, codex, copilot, cursor, devin, droid, grok, hermes, kilo, kimi, kiro, maki, mastracode, muse, omp, opencode, pi, qodercli and qwen.

sources.title: Sidecar UI API v0
sources.locator: Process and discovery, Listeners and trust
sources.finding: sidecar api serve exposes the Sessions catalog and terminals over HTTP and WebSocket with local Unix socket, loopback browser and optional tailnet listeners and pairing; the reference web UI is a separate directory not included in this repository.

sources.title: Driving an agent on another machine
sources.finding: Remote hosts run sidecar agent verbs over SSH with two feature flags; no second protocol or daemon; conversation identifiers stay on the host.

sources.title: Mobile terminal protocol v0
sources.finding: sidecar mobile serve --stdio is the authenticated SSH exec endpoint for a native client; no shipped mobile app in this repository.

sources.title: Sidecar mobile plan
sources.finding: Plan for an iPhone and iPad Sessions app that is not released; Android later.

sources.title: Notifications and alerting
sources.locator: Posting notifications, Sources and lifecycle cues
sources.finding: In-app toasts and a notification centre fed by sidecar notify post and agent lifecycle cues, with jump targets.

sources.title: Worktree creation and setup
sources.finding: Worktree creation validates the branch and source commit, copies env files and runs a setup hook with a confirmation; no remote push at creation.

sources.title: Privacy
sources.locator: Local Data Access, Network Requests, Local UI API
sources.finding: No telemetry; network limited to GitHub version checks (cached 3 hours), user-initiated changelog and updates, gh and git actions; conversations plugin off by default and read-only.

sources.title: Feature flags
sources.finding: Registry with defaults: agent_control false, sidecar_remote_hosts false, conversations_plugin false, tasks_plugin false, workspace and pane flags true.

sources.title: GoReleaser config
sources.finding: Builds darwin and linux binaries for amd64 and arm64 only.

sources.title: Changelog
sources.finding: Weekly releases; v1.16.0 added the UI API; v1.17.0 added browser approval and tailnet access.

sources.title: td README
sources.locator: What td Does, Boards, Dependencies, Epics, Design Philosophy
sources.finding: td tracks issues with handoffs, session-based review, boards with TDQ queries, dependency graphs and critical path, epics, work sessions, file links; local SQLite in .todos; MIT.

sources.title: td MIT license
sources.finding: MIT license for td.

sources.title: td sync client guide
sources.finding: Optional manual push and pull of issues, logs, comments, handoffs, boards and dependencies to a td-sync server shared by team members.

sources.title: td-sync operator guide
sources.finding: Self-run td-sync Go server with device-flow and API-key auth, per-project SQLite, memberships and Litestream replication.

sources.title: Sidecar UI API tailnet login allowlist
sources.locator: Direct mode; "The identity is the device, not the person"; config api.tailnetLogins
sources.finding: Config api.tailnetLogins lists tailnet logins that may use the UI API; any untagged device of an allowed login can drive the owner terminals, with identity at device level only.
